meta.title: Ondra Prompt Injection
meta.description: What she recalls this turn is decided by a box: items are packed into a character budget in global weight order, and when one does not fit the packer skips it and tries the next. The count that did not fit is written into the section heading. Due promises and pinned memories never enter the box, because dropping either once reads to the user as 'she forgot what we agreed on'.
